properties.description: 기존 주제에서 연구 요약·역할 있는 배치·정확한 원문으로 이동하는 조회용 지도.

properties.name: Target identity, authority, and adaptive method boundary
properties.description: The target is one token-native LLM-function macro-neural HSWM whose evolving canonical hypergraph jointly serves as living harness, world model, and continuous learner. This is target identity, not a completion or efficacy result; realization mechanisms remain replaceable.
historical_questions: Which replaceable realization can meet the target without lowering its intervention, outcome, and provenance requirements?
What finite evidence sequence is sufficient for a bounded v1 milestone while leaving the broader target unclaimed?

properties.name: Fractal cognitive composition and scientific connections
properties.description: FCL-1 through FCL-8 specify the intended same-type, outcome-bound composition of cognition-bearing HSWMs. Literature supplies connected constructs and falsification bridges, not evidence that an integrated HSWM or consciousness exists.
historical_questions: Can a macro-state produce a reproducible intervention effect beyond matched micro, wrapper, and central-control alternatives?
Can the same contract be demonstrated at two scales while preserving rights, exit, provenance, and lineage?

properties.name: Conceptual C1-C3 work and conditional capability contracts
properties.description: Connected-concept workshops and conditional capability contracts record design vocabulary and constrained interfaces. They are authored proposals or drafts, not executed causal-learning stages.
historical_questions: Which C1-C3 concepts become necessary in a preregistered causal mechanism, rather than remaining design vocabulary?
Can a capability boundary be exercised without becoming a canonical-write or learning bypass?

properties.name: Causal-composition experiment spine and adversarial controls
properties.description: The G0-G6 program defines a staged test route from measurement integrity to replication and scale stress, with explicit nulls for model, retrieval, orchestration, sham revision, leakage, holdout reuse, and composition illusion.
historical_questions: Can one declared mechanism beat strong information- and resource-matched controls on a fresh task?
Can outcome, credit, revision, and changed behavior be causally identified without leakage or holdout reuse?

properties.name: Closure plan, bounded v1 done state, and adversarial audit
properties.description: The latest closure snapshot carries ratified D-1, D-3, and D-4, completed S-2 through S-4, and open S-5/S-6. It preserves adverse findings and does not promote the observed opaque-task segment into a completed v1 causal-learning result.
historical_questions: Who provides the second-party role needed for G0-external, or is that gate explicitly left unstarted?
What single run will satisfy D-4's outcome-to-real-canonical-revision-to-changed-heldout-behavior contract?

properties.name: Opaque identifiability experiments and preserved negative results
properties.description: Opaque-task studies demonstrate bounded local state-readout identifiability under declared conditions. Earlier control clauses and the first value-revealing G1-shaped task exposed non-separation and baseline saturation; none establishes HSWM learning efficacy.
historical_questions: Can a non-saturated held-out task identify a causal effect of a durable canonical revision?
Can the local result be independently replayed and externally adjudicated without changing its frozen protocol?

properties.name: Constructive realizability program and bounded proof round
properties.description: The proof program separates conditional evidence composition from construction of the premises. The first round checked three bounded formal models and counterexamples; it did not prove a full HSWM, causal efficacy, or any FCL passage.
historical_questions: Can causal identification, multiscale credit, useful topology, world-self continuity, and composition be constructed rather than assumed?
Can one simultaneous runtime witness satisfy all required obligations under external outcome evaluation?

properties.name: Relation learning, RU-1 successor, and LLM calibration
properties.description: The finite relation instrument qualified a local transport and DSL path but tied an information-matched native learner. RR-1 was rejected as a representation-only contrast; RU-1 is a proposed outcome-conditioned update candidate. Actual LLM calibration calls remain zero.
historical_questions: What exact model, independent outcome custody, source cutoff, cohort, metric, and total resource accounting will make RU-1 testable?
Can RU-1 beat native history, text, program, and frozen-policy controls with removal, sham, and restoration?

properties.name: Native Effect runtime and ICE learning remediation
properties.description: The native TypeScript/Effect adaptive runtime and ICE graph WP0-WP3 are implemented local engineering. Selection effect, goal effect, learner-v2 comparison, stage feedback, revision, and real-use efficacy remain unimplemented or unidentified.
historical_questions: Can co-eligible alternatives and outcome-bound feedback identify a local selection effect?
Can remediation proposals be implemented and then compared under matched cost and outcome contracts?

properties.name: Canonical graph engineering and standards interoperability
properties.description: Graph-and-loop artifacts implement local canonical-atom, journal, projection, and enforcement engineering with RDF, JSON-LD, PROV-O, SHACL, and related standards. These interfaces are bounded projections and do not themselves constitute HSWM cognition or efficacy.
historical_questions: Can the implemented canonical path be bound to an independently evaluated outcome and changed behavior?
What mapping loss remains when standards-based projections are used as bounded views?

properties.name: Research coordination graph and USL interface boundaries
properties.description: The research-coordination CLI and USL bridge provide bounded engineering views for planning, lineage, JSON-LD/RDF/PROV exchange, and property-graph access. They retain negative results but do not execute learning, establish actor independence, or write canonical state.
historical_questions: How can bounded coordination artifacts remain useful without being misreported as HSWM cognition or learning?
Can a source-authenticated external graph interface support a future experiment without becoming a canonical-write path?

properties.name: Learning literature, frontier theory, and baseline discipline
properties.description: Literature and reuse-first material identify candidate mechanisms and strong baseline families. They are reference inputs and do not establish that HSWM has their capabilities or an advantage over them.
historical_questions: Which strong native, text, program, retrieval, and fixed-orchestration baselines are appropriate for each claimed mechanism?
Can any bounded HSWM mechanism retain an effect after those matched alternatives are tested?

properties.name: Historical evidence, RED paths, and parallel research programs
properties.description: Past outcomes, including scalar slow-weight P1 RED and DNRD-5 diagnostics, remain evidence with their exact scopes. Ragnarok and PIDNA are initialized research programs, not evidence of an integrated HSWM. Historical records must stay navigable without being used to rescue failed mechanisms.
historical_questions: Which historical mechanism families are retired, underdetermined, or still eligible for a distinct successor hypothesis?
How should negative-result lineage be surfaced in a standard graph without implying a current live learning path?
